# Mac app — Controls

## Buttons and pills

![Buttons and pills](data:image/webp;base64,)

### ScreenStyle.swift
- OmniPageHeader: eyebrow caption (pb10), title 30 medium tracking -0.3, subtitle 13.5 fg3 max 576 pt6, actions right gap 8
- LoadingNote: Loader 14 + label 13 fg3, py24
- Hairline 1px line
- hoverWash r18 surface
- omniGroup: pad 18x14 card r20
- FieldLabel 12.5 medium fg2 + hint 12 fg3, pb6
- FieldBox r14 surface + line stroke pad 12x7
- OmniToggleStyle: 38x22 track fg on / surface3 off; knob 18 onInk / white(eceae5 dark) shadow .18 r1.5
- OmniMonoFieldStyle 13 mono pad v10
- OmniTextEditor min 84
- SettingsPage pad 24x22 gap 16 bg
- SettingsCard r24 line ring pad 20; title 16 medium -0.16; note 12.5 fg3; trailing actions; gap 14
- SettingsIntro: icon 15 in 32 bg circle, text 12.5 fg2, pad 16 card r20
- InfoRows pad 6 card r20; InfoRow label 12.5 fg3 w112, value 13 fg, minH 36 pad 10
- DoneNote: done glyph 8 + 12.5 fg2; NeedsNote: needs glyph 8 + 12.5 fg

### ThreadStyle.swift
- column 768, thread 896; prose 14, small 12.5, mono 11.5, card 20
- StatusPill: glyph 6 + 12 medium; h24 pl8 pr10; running: surface2 bg live text; needs: needs bg ink; done: done bg ink; else surface2 fg2
- GlyphView: running = live disc + ping (scale 2.6, opacity .55→0, 1.6s); needs = rotated rounded square r1.5 scale .86 (needs color, ink on pop); done = volt disc + doneEdge 1px (ink on pop); settled fg4 disc; idle/queued hollow ring fg4 1.5
- Status map: running, queued, done, failed→needs, imported→idle, else settled
- Pre: mono 11.5, line spacing 4, fg2 (bad fg), pad 12x10, r12 surface + line stroke; tall → scroll 320; tones add/delete bg
- Spinner = Loader 12 live
- CopyableMessage: hover "Copy"/"Copied" 11.5 medium fg4 h22 with doc.on.doc / checkmark
